title: Men of War
provenance: Reported by valdroff (highball-db#1480, 2026-11-26), an iMac from 2023 (Apple M3), macOS 27.2, the Highball version not stated, engine x64-crossover26.3-r35 by the launch log, WineD3D, rated 1 of 5: started from Steam in an environment named play, the game only brought up Wine's debugger. The log ends on an unhandled illegal instruction at 00F1E227, inside mow.exe, which runs as a 32-bit program, and the backtrace attached to the report has no stack for it. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Best Way's 2009 World War II strategy game, on Steam from Fulqrum Publishing. Doesn't start in one report on an M3 iMac with the Wine 11 engine r35 and WineD3D: mow.exe stops on an illegal instruction in its own code and Wine's debugger opens. Other engines weren't tried.

knownIssues.symptom: The game doesn't start. mow.exe stops on an unhandled illegal instruction at 00F1E227 and Wine's debugger opens (M3 iMac, Wine 11 r35, WineD3D, highball-db#1480)
knownIssues.cause: not diagnosed. The address is inside mow.exe's own code. Which instruction it is, and whether Rosetta lacks it, isn't known
